title: The Beacon — Baker Road Baptist Church, Baytown TX
metaDescription: The Beacon, the weekly newsletter of Baker Road Baptist Church in Baytown, Texas. This Sunday's schedule, classes, serving rotas and what is coming up.
headline: This week at Baker Road.
intro: The same newsletter handed out on Sunday morning, posted here every week so you can read it on your phone during the week.

sections.heading: Where else to look
sections.body: The Beacon is a snapshot of one week. For the things that do not change week to week, these pages are kept up to date.

items.title: Watch a message
items.body: Every sermon, going back to 2025, with the full service one click away.

items.title: Ministries and groups
items.body: Children, students, adult Bible study, the Care Ministry and the Pumpkin Patch.

items.title: Ask the office
items.body: If something in this week's Beacon needs explaining, the office is glad to help.
